profile.encoding_operations_scope: Instrumented simulation-thread API call sites in observed latest-ledger frames only. Buffer bytes are requested sizes; initialized bytes are create-with-data payloads, not measured PCIe traffic. CPU scopes exclude parameter-byte construction and GPU execution. Initial render-world preparation, uninstrumented helpers, driver allocations and skipped ledger frames are not counted. Gather/spawn scopes include command encoding; other scopes measure allocation/bind-group calls.

event_scratch_retained.scope: Render-world cache ownership, not driver residency or completed-submission frees.

parameter_scratch_retained.scope: CPU-visible GPU handle ownership, not driver residency.

profile.render_graph_scope: Paired timestamps around RenderGraph Begin through Render and selected-light copy, before diagnostic resolve/submission. GPU includes intervening graph work and gaps, not presentation latency or every upload. CPU is command-encoding wall time, not whole-game CPU or active CPU cycles. Nested scopes overlap; never add their quantiles.
profile.scope: Separate instrumented lane. GPU phases are asynchronous distinct measurement times; per-owner results are deduplicated by owner/sequence and may omit retired or budget-omitted owners. Work totals cover observed timestamp windows only. Nested GPU scopes overlap; do not add parent and child durations. CPU activation excludes render-thread allocation/submission. No replay/seek or screenshots. Unpartitioned profiling omits capacity scans; opt-in partitioned transport includes bounded health scans in every lane.

simulation_phase_sampling.scope: Opt-in diagnostic lane with extra GPU marker passes. One category per frame, at most 1024 pairs and three in-flight slots. Complete totals sum disjoint segments within that category/frame; overflow or invalid timestamps are unknown. Categories sample different frames: never add their percentiles. Missing windows may include unsupported timestamps, busy slots or missed latest results. Excludes domain advance, analytic/trail preparation, checkpoints outside trail recording, and other graph work. Do not compare this lane's aggregate costs to runs without phase sampling.

stateful_render_preparation.scope: Latest CPU stateful preparation system windows only; excludes ShaderBuffer asset preparation, other render systems, submission, driver allocation and GPU execution. May skip frames.

planar_reflection.scope: Queued draw counts, not GPU completion or live-particle counts; target estimate excludes view-local draw buffers
